thread:
michelle: Quick thread to sort Priya's partial-FTE phased return questions before her Jun 20 leave. Priya asked about how reduced-FTE weeks interact with benefits/top-up and whether she needs to elect COBRA for any gap.

priya: Thanks! Main things I need clarified: 1) If I come back 60% for 8 weeks, does that reduce my paid top-up weeks or is it an adjunct? 2) Do I have to change my elections or will benefits continue? 3) Who approves the modified schedule?

michelle: Short answers: 1) Phased return (documented modified schedule) doesn't reduce your primary paid leave weeks; top-up eligibility for the phased weeks is manager + HR approved and depends on available top-up balance. 2) Benefits remain active if your FTE stays >= 50% during the payroll month; otherwise payroll will ask you to elect COBRA. 3) Manager approval + HR sign-off required. We'll route approvals via the leave form.

leah: From benefits ops: confirm that benefits continue if the employee is on approved paid leave or returns at >=50% in the pay period. Payroll will recalc deductions if there's a mid-month FTE drop. If that happens, benefits@ can advise on COBRA notices.

payroll-bot: Payroll note: to lock top-up for phased weeks you need: (a) manager sign-off in writing, (b) signed leave form in ADP by cutoff (20th), (c) weekly schedule for modified hours if reduced-FTE. Late submissions -> top-up starts next cycle; retro adjustments possible.

ash: Manager here. I approve 60% for 8 weeks for Priya. @michelle please log approval in the HR tool so payroll sees it. We'll also move any high-priority tickets off her board and ask for volunteer coverage for the docs.

priya: Thanks Ash! Also quick question about state-paid family leave stacking: I'm in CA. Can Redwood top-up stack with CA PFL? Michelle?

michelle: Yes CA State benefits can stack with company top-up. Process: employee files claim with EDD; once state benefit amt is known, payroll coordinates the top-up to reach the company guaranteed % (per policy). That can cause small retro payments after the state determines amt.

it-ops-bot: Logistics: if Priya wants to keep laptop while on leave mark "retain" in IT ticket. Otherwise request a return label via #it-asset and we'll schedule pickup. For long-term equipment loans during phased return (e.g., docking station), open ticket with subject "parental-equipment-hold".

michelle: Action items: 1) Priya -> sign & submit leave form in HR portal today if possible. 2) Ash -> confirm coverage plan and on-call handoff in the Team Handoffs doc. 3) Leah/benefits -> monitor EDD/CA stacking and advise payroll. 4) Priya -> indicate equipment preference in IT ticket. Ping me if anyone wants a 10m call. :wave:
